services.desc: Join us on Saturday, October 17, 2026, from 2 PM, for a conversation with artists from What Quilts Carry about quilting, shared foundations, and the lasting influence of KCAI’s quilting tradition. Moderated by Kim Eichler-Messmer, followed by audience Q&A. Free & open to the public. See you there! Join a group of artists from What Quilts Carry: Eighteen Years of Quilting at KCAI for a conversation about the lasting influence of Quilts: More than the Sum of Their Parts, the Kansas City Art Institute studio course developed and taught by Kim Eichler-Messmer since 2008. blurb: The Leedy-Voulkos Art Center (LVAC) is a nonprofit public charity and a living artist community rooted in Jim Leedy’s vision for Leedyville. For more than four decades, LVAC has provided a place where artists can create, exhibit, connect, and flourish.
